prTitle: feat(uptime): Add ability to use queues to manage parallelism
head: 9966ec5a13e331659c3ea00981f9b11b0faf821f

prOriginalConhecido.nota: Found by title search (branch danf/uptime-queue-consumer). Benchmark head 9966ec5a is the PR's last commit; same 7 files. Squash-merged as 33f4fddf.

tps.bug: SimpleQueueProcessingStrategy passes FilteredPayload to decode_payload, whose assert raises instead of returning None, so filtered messages go through the error path.
tps.evidenciaOpus: result_consumer.py:188 asserts the payload is not FilteredPayload, but SimpleQueueProcessingStrategy is the first step returned by create_thread_queue_parallel_worker (lines 245-259) with no upstream filter, so Kafka never delivers FilteredPayload to it; even if it did, the except at queue_consumer.py:317-325 still completes the offset.
tps.evidenciaAstra: src/sentry/remote_subscriptions/consumers/result_consumer.py:256 wires decode_payload directly, whose assertion at line 188 rejects FilteredPayload. queue_consumer.py:295 invokes that decoder before the None check, causing filtered messages to produce the erroneous exception log at line 318; lines 319–325 still complete their offsets through the fallback.
